[ASSISTANT_SAID] The correct pronunciation of "konnichiwa" is /koh-n-nee-chee-wah/.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Breakdown of "konnichiwa": "kon" is pronounced as "koh-n", "nichi" as "nee-chee", and "wa" as "wah".  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for pronouncing "konnichiwa" include paying attention to pitch, not overemphasizing the "w" sound, and practicing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested options to get from JFK Airport to Tokyo include Narita Express, Keisei Skyliner, and various bus services.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] From Haneda Airport, options include Tokyo Monorail, Keikyu Railway, and buses.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended taking a taxi or bus if the user has a lot of luggage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested using a Suica or Pasmo card for public transportation in Tokyo.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Directions from Shinjuku Station to Park Hyatt Tokyo include exiting at the South Exit and walking straight on Shinjuku-dori Street.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Alternative option to take a taxi from Shinjuku Station to Park Hyatt Tokyo, costing around ¥800-1,000 (~$7-9 USD).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended restaurants near Park Hyatt Tokyo include Sushi Saito, Narisawa, Yakiniku Jumbo Han no Daidokoro Bettei, Tofuya Ukai, Ichiran Ramen, and Tsukiji Itadori Uogashi.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested making reservations for popular restaurants, especially Sushi Saito and Narisawa.
